major_finding_summary: F-CAND-D-1 threshold 0.01 first crossed at canonical magnitude 50.0. Major finding criterion 2 (drift > 1.0) NOT hit across swept range. Trajectory shape=sub_linear. Architectural inject visible but bounded; BG-Q canonical 0.5 was below noise floor.
platform: mac CPU (.venv-eeg python3.12, transformers, torch fp32)
honest_c3: C1 — High-magnitude inject (mag=50, 100) is structurally UNREALISTIC. Paradigm v11 G3 actual training-time injection distribution NOT yet extracted from C-module emission logs. If training used mag~0.1-1.0, F-CAND-D-1 PASS only at mag>>1.0 means architectural channel works but is OFF-DISTRIBUTION at any realistic inject. Calibration extraction is gating before Stage 1 promotion regardless of trajectory shape.

C2 — Trajectory classification heuristic uses drift-growth-ratio / magnitude-growth-ratio bands (linear: 0.7-1.5, saturate: <0.3 in upper-3, super_linear: >1.5 in upper-3, explosion: >100 OR NaN). These bands are anima-internal, not cross-validated. A trajectory that genuinely transitions from linear to saturated near the upper magnitudes may classify as either depending on band cutoffs. Manual inspection of the drift_table is required for final shape interpretation.

C3 — phi_star is a pairwise-cosine proxy on tile-replicated post-ln_f cell (8×192). Magnitude scaling enters phi via cos(theta) which is BOUNDED by [-1, 1]. As inject magnitude grows, the inject component dominates the post-ln_f tiling and phi_star drift may saturate at roughly ±0.05×PHI_STAR_BASELINE = ±2.09 due to the cosine ceiling, NOT due to architectural cap. Saturation in trajectory ≠ cross_attn attenuation — could be measurement-instrument ceiling.

C4 — Single prompt ("안녕"). BG-Q showed prompt 1 had 8x larger drift than prompts 2/3/5, so this is the most-favorable prompt. Other prompts may show different trajectories (e.g. attenuation cap reached earlier). Single-prompt sweep cannot generalize prompt-conditional behavior.

C5 — Cells 5-7 fill scales linearly with magnitude (mean(cells[0..4]) × mag/3). At high magnitudes, cells 5-7 norms grow with mag^2 effectively (cells 0-4 grow with mag, then mean×mag/3 carries another mag factor). This means the inject distribution shape DRIFTS with magnitude — high-magnitude inject is NOT just a scaled version of low-magnitude inject. Pure linearity test would require holding cells-5-7-fill formula constant while scaling axis-content; current implementation entangles them.
